01 / About Printix

A creative idea.
A physical expression.

Printix is a company dedicated to the fabrication of custom parts and art pieces, using 3D and traditional printing methods.

At the heart of the brand is a simple commitment: quality, attention to detail, and the essence of Printix in every piece.

A closer look

Get to know
Printix.

What does Printix create?

Printix fabricates custom parts and art pieces. Its work combines creative expression with physical making.

Which printing methods does Printix use?

Printix uses both 3D printing and traditional printing methods.

What does the Printix mark represent?

The logo is a signature of authenticity. It represents quality, attention to detail, and the essence of Printix in each piece.
